description: This Java class implements a FreeMarker template transform (TemplateTransformModel) for rendering sub-content within the Apache OFBiz framework. It provides methods to retrieve content based on parameters and integrates with OFBiz's content, content worker, and web utilities to render content blocks inside templates.

classes.name: RenderSubContentTransform
classes.description: Implements a FreeMarker transform to include sub-content in templates by rendering content identified by contentId or subContentId.

methods.name: getWriter
methods.description: Provides a Writer that, upon closing, renders the specified sub-content into the template output.

methods.name: renderSubContent
methods.description: Handles the actual rendering of the sub-content, fetching content and writing it to output, and updating context variables.

methods.name: getArg
methods.description: Deprecated utility to fetch arguments, replaced by FreeMarkerWorker.getArg().
